senses.zh: có thể đoán trước; dễ đoán
senses.en: Happening or behaving in a way that can be expected.
Boring because nothing surprising or original happens.

ex.en: The film's predictable ending made us laugh rather than cry.
A predictable income helps families plan their spending and reduces the stress associated with financial uncertainty.

col: predictable pattern｜mô thức có thể dự đoán
tip: Có thể chỉ kết quả đoán được, cũng có thể chê cốt truyện sáo mòn.

senses.en: to discover something previously hidden or unknown

senses.zh: mở nắp; bỏ vật che phủ
senses.en: to remove something covering an object or surface

ex.en: Our kitchen repairs helped uncover a hidden water leak.
Independent research can uncover environmental risks that are overlooked during the early stages of industrial development.

col: uncover the truth｜làm sáng tỏ sự thật
uncover a problem｜phát hiện một vấn đề
tip: Có thể chỉ việc bỏ vật che phủ ra, cũng có thể là phát hiện sự thật bị giấu kín.

senses.en: unkind or excessively severe in judging or treating others
very difficult or unpleasant to live in or experience
unpleasantly strong and uncomfortable to the senses

ex.en: His harsh criticism upset everyone at the dinner table.
Farmers in regions with harsh climates need reliable irrigation systems to maintain stable food production.

col: harsh criticism｜lời chỉ trích khắc nghiệt
tip: Mạnh hơn strict, nhấn mạnh sự khắc nghiệt đến mức khó chịu hoặc khó chịu đựng.

senses.en: To look like or be similar to someone or something

ex.en: These clouds resemble small boats floating across the sky.
Modern learning spaces increasingly resemble collaborative workplaces rather than traditional classrooms with fixed rows of desks.

tip: Đi thẳng với tân ngữ: resemble someone, không thêm to hay with.

senses.en: a seat on a horse or bicycle
to put a saddle on a horse
to give someone an unwanted responsibility or burden

ex.en: I lowered the saddle before riding my new bicycle.
Excessive university fees can saddle graduates with debts that limit their career choices for many years.

col: saddle a horse｜thắng yên cho ngựa
be saddled with debt｜bị đè nặng bởi nợ nần
tip: saddle someone with nghĩa là đặt lên ai gánh nặng không mong muốn.

senses.en: a power believed to control what happens in people's lives

senses.zh: kết cục; số phận (của ai, vật gì)
senses.en: what eventually happens to someone or something, often something bad

ex.en: It felt like fate when we met again.
The fate of many endangered species depends on whether governments protect their habitats from further destruction.

col: leave something to fate｜phó mặc cho số phận
seal someone's fate｜định đoạt số phận của ai
suffer the same fate｜chịu chung số phận
tip: Nghĩa “thiên mệnh” thường không đếm được; a terrible fate chỉ kết cục bi thảm.

senses.en: Feeling nearly hopeless and ready to try anything.

senses.zh: khao khát cháy bỏng; rất cần
senses.en: Wanting or needing something very badly.
Extremely serious or dangerous and needing immediate action.

ex.en: Desperate to find her cat, Aisha searched every nearby garden.
After prolonged drought, farming communities face desperate conditions and require urgent support to restore their livelihoods.

col: desperate for help｜rất cần giúp đỡ
desperate to escape｜liều mạng muốn trốn thoát
a desperate attempt｜một nỗ lực liều lĩnh
desperate measures｜biện pháp cực đoan bất đắc dĩ
tip: Khao khát điều gì dùng desperate for; khao khát làm việc gì dùng to do.

senses.en: The framework of bones supporting a human or animal body.
A basic structure to which more details can be added.

ex.en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
Studying the skeleton of an ancient animal can reveal how it moved and adapted to its environment.

col: skeleton staff｜đội ngũ nhân viên tối thiểu
tip: skeleton staff là số nhân viên tối thiểu cần để duy trì hoạt động.

senses.en: an action taken to prevent danger, damage, or problems

ex.en: We packed an extra torch as a precaution.
Taking basic safety precautions in laboratories can prevent accidents and protect both students and teaching staff.

col: take precautions｜thực hiện biện pháp phòng ngừa
as a precaution｜như một biện pháp đề phòng
a precaution against fire｜biện pháp phòng cháy
tip: Hay dùng take precautions; as a precaution nghĩa là để phòng xa.

senses.en: Someone competing for a job or an elected position.
Someone taking an examination.

ex.en: Each candidate waited outside the office before their interview.
Employers should assess each candidate fairly rather than rely on assumptions about their educational or cultural background.

col: candidate for a position｜ứng viên cho một vị trí
tip: candidate for đi kèm vị trí ứng tuyển hoặc chức vụ tranh cử.

senses.en: A book or website explaining many subjects or one field.

ex.en: I found a fascinating dinosaur picture in this encyclopedia.
An online encyclopedia offers convenient background information, but students should verify important claims using reliable academic sources.

col: online encyclopedia｜bách khoa toàn thư trực tuyến
consult an encyclopedia｜tra cứu bách khoa toàn thư
tip: Anh–Anh cũng hay viết là encyclopaedia.

senses.en: larger than normal because of injury or illness
carrying more water than usual after heavy rain

ex.en: My ankle was swollen after I fell during practice.
After several days of heavy rain, the swollen river threatened homes built close to its banks.

col: a swollen ankle｜mắt cá chân sưng
a swollen river｜con sông nước dâng
tip: Cũng là quá khứ phân từ của swell; quá khứ là swelled.

senses.en: The general opinion people have about someone or something.

ex.en: This little bakery has a reputation for excellent bread.
Companies that respond honestly to customer complaints are more likely to maintain a good reputation.

col: build a reputation｜xây dựng danh tiếng
damage someone's reputation｜làm tổn hại danh tiếng của ai
a reputation for quality｜tiếng tốt về chất lượng
tip: Dùng reputation for + đặc điểm; danh tiếng có thể tốt hoặc xấu.

senses.zh: làm tỉnh táo; làm sảng khoái
senses.en: To make someone feel less tired or more comfortable.
To load the latest version of displayed information.
To help someone remember something learned or experienced before.

ex.en: A cool shower refreshed me after the long walk.
Regular breaks can refresh employees and help them maintain concentration during tasks that require sustained mental effort.

col: refresh your memory｜gợi lại trí nhớ
refresh your skills｜ôn lại kỹ năng
tip: Người thấy tỉnh táo dùng refreshed; điều làm sảng khoái dùng refreshing.

senses.en: soft, smooth, and often shiny like silk
pleasantly smooth and gentle in sound

ex.en: This conditioner leaves my hair feeling soft and silky.
Consumers often prefer fabrics with a silky texture, although their production may require substantial chemical processing.

col: silky texture｜kết cấu mượt như lụa
tip: silky nhấn mạnh sự mượt như lụa, không nhất thiết làm bằng lụa thật.

senses.zh: người giúp việc nhà; nhân viên buồng phòng
senses.en: Someone employed to clean and look after homes or hotel rooms.

ex.en: The housekeeper left fresh towels beside the bathroom sink.
Hotels should provide housekeepers with suitable equipment and sufficient time to clean each room safely.

col: hotel housekeeper｜nhân viên buồng phòng khách sạn
live-in housekeeper｜người giúp việc ở lại nhà chủ
hire a housekeeper｜thuê người giúp việc
tip: Chỉ người được thuê dọn dẹp nhà hoặc phòng, không phân biệt giới tính.

senses.en: pressure or difficulty that tests someone's strength or resources

senses.zh: làm căng cơ; gắng sức quá mức
senses.en: to injure or overwork a muscle or body part

senses.zh: giống; chủng (vi sinh vật); biến thể
senses.en: a particular type of plant, animal, or microorganism

ex.en: I strained my back while lifting that heavy box.
Rapid population growth puts considerable strain on public services, particularly housing and healthcare in large cities.

col: put a strain on｜gây áp lực lên
a strain of virus｜một chủng virus
tip: strain có thể chỉ chấn thương căng cơ; sprain chủ yếu là bong gân khớp.

senses.en: Make something straight, or become straight.
Move your body into an upright position.

ex.en: She paused to straighten her tie before the interview.
Regular stretching can help office workers straighten their backs and reduce discomfort caused by prolonged sitting.

col: straighten up｜đứng thẳng người; dọn dẹp gọn gàng
straighten out a problem｜giải quyết vấn đề
tip: straighten up có thể là đứng thẳng người hoặc dọn dẹp cho gọn gàng.

senses.zh: độ chính xác; sự đúng đắn
senses.en: the quality of being correct or free from errors

ex.en: Please check the accuracy of these measurements before cutting.
The accuracy of climate predictions depends partly on the quality of data collected over long periods.

col: check the accuracy of｜kiểm tra độ chính xác của
improve accuracy｜nâng cao độ chính xác
a high degree of accuracy｜độ chính xác cao
historical accuracy｜tính chính xác về lịch sử
tip: Thường là danh từ không đếm được; tính từ là accurate.

senses.en: A discussion in which people express different views.
To discuss a subject by considering different views.
To think carefully about options before making a decision.

ex.en: We had a lively debate about keeping pets indoors.
The debate over free public transport centres on its environmental benefits and the cost to taxpayers.

col: heated debate｜cuộc tranh luận nảy lửa
debate an issue｜thảo luận một vấn đề
debate whether to｜cân nhắc xem có nên
tip: Động từ có thể đi thẳng với vấn đề; debate whether to nghĩa là cân nhắc có nên làm gì.

senses.en: A covered area immediately outside a building's entrance.

ex.en: We left our muddy boots on the porch overnight.
A shaded porch can reduce indoor temperatures while providing residents with a comfortable outdoor meeting space.

col: sit on the porch｜ngồi ở hiên nhà
tip: Chỉ khoảng không có mái che ngay trước cửa vào, không phải hành lang trong nhà.

senses.en: the gathering of crops, or the crops gathered
to gather crops when they are ready

ex.en: We celebrated the apple harvest with a homemade pie.
Unpredictable rainfall can reduce the annual harvest, threatening rural incomes and increasing food prices in cities.

col: a good harvest｜một vụ mùa bội thu
tip: Là danh từ, có thể chỉ việc thu hoạch hoặc sản lượng nông sản thu được.

senses.en: to establish an organization, institution, or settlement

senses.zh: đã tìm thấy (quá khứ của find)
senses.en: past tense and past participle of find

ex.en: My aunt founded a small charity last winter.
Graduates who found new businesses can create employment opportunities and introduce innovative services to local communities.

col: found a company｜thành lập công ty
found a school｜thành lập trường học
found a charity｜thành lập tổ chức từ thiện
tip: Quá khứ của “thành lập” là founded; nguyên mẫu của “tìm thấy” là find.

senses.en: A chemical element needed for strong bones and teeth

ex.en: This yoghurt provides calcium for healthy bones and teeth.
School meals should include adequate sources of calcium to support children's bone development during periods of rapid growth.

col: calcium supplements｜thực phẩm bổ sung canxi
tip: Danh từ không đếm được; ký hiệu hoá học là Ca.

senses.en: in a way relating to money, trade, or the economy

senses.zh: tiết kiệm; hiệu quả kinh tế
senses.en: using little money, fuel, or other resources

ex.en: The town depends economically on its busy fishing harbour.
Renewable energy projects are becoming economically viable as production costs fall and demand for cleaner electricity rises.

col: economically viable｜khả thi về mặt kinh tế
economically disadvantaged｜có hoàn cảnh kinh tế khó khăn
economically dependent｜phụ thuộc về kinh tế
tip: Gồm cả nghĩa “về kinh tế” của economic và nghĩa “tiết kiệm” của economical.

senses.en: A strong building or enclosed place built for military defence.

ex.en: We climbed the hill to explore the old fort.
Restoring the coastal fort could attract tourists while preserving an important part of the region's military history.

tip: fort thiên về quân sự phòng thủ; castle thường kiêm nơi ở của quý tộc.

senses.en: A woody plant with several stems, usually smaller than a tree

ex.en: A small bird was hiding beneath the flowering shrub.
Planting native shrubs in urban parks provides shelter for wildlife and can reduce the need for irrigation.

tip: Danh từ đếm được, chỉ từng cây bụi; một khu cây bụi dùng shrubbery.

senses.en: related to education, study, or research

senses.zh: giảng viên đại học; học giả
senses.en: someone who teaches or researches at a university

senses.zh: thuần lý thuyết; không thực tế
senses.en: theoretical rather than useful in a practical situation

ex.en: The school praised her academic progress this year.
Universities should support students' emotional wellbeing rather than focusing exclusively on academic achievement and examination results.

tip: Khi là danh từ chỉ giảng viên hoặc nhà nghiên cứu đại học, thường không chỉ sinh viên.

senses.en: To rub a surface until it becomes smooth and shiny.
To improve something by making small, careful changes.
A substance used to make a surface smooth and shiny.

ex.en: I polish my shoes before every important meeting.
University students should learn to polish their writing by removing unnecessary words and organising arguments logically.

col: polish an essay｜trau chuốt bài luận
furniture polish｜chất đánh bóng đồ gỗ
tip: polish viết thường là đánh bóng; Polish viết hoa nghĩa là thuộc Ba Lan, phát âm khác.

senses.en: A place where waste is buried in the ground.
The disposal of waste by burying it in the ground.

ex.en: The truck carried our rubbish to a nearby landfill.
Expanding recycling services could reduce the amount of household waste sent to landfill each year.

col: send waste to landfill｜đưa rác đi chôn lấp
landfill capacity｜sức chứa của bãi chôn lấp
tip: Khi chỉ bãi chôn lấp thì đếm được; khi chỉ việc xử lý bằng chôn lấp thì thường không đếm được.

senses.en: A person or business that buys and sells particular goods.
The person who gives out cards in a card game.

ex.en: The dealer showed us three reliable used cars.
Consumers should choose a reputable dealer when purchasing secondhand vehicles to reduce the risk of hidden defects.

col: a car dealer｜đại lý ô tô
an art dealer｜nhà buôn tác phẩm nghệ thuật
a reputable dealer｜đại lý uy tín
tip: Thường thêm loại hàng phía trước, như car dealer, để rõ lĩnh vực kinh doanh.

senses.en: Writing arranged with rhythm, often using rhyme.

senses.zh: khổ thơ; đoạn lời bài hát
senses.en: A group of lines forming part of a poem or song.

ex.en: We sang the first verse together around the piano.
Studying verse can help language learners recognise rhythm and explore how writers convey complex emotions.

col: the opening verse｜khổ thơ mở đầu
tip: Chỉ thơ nói chung thì không đếm được; chỉ một khổ thơ thì đếm được.

senses.en: a greater liking for one thing than for another

senses.zh: sự ưu tiên; quyền ưu tiên
senses.en: an advantage given to someone or something over others

ex.en: My preference is tea, but coffee is fine too.
Consumer preference for locally grown food can encourage sustainable farming and reduce transport emissions.

col: a preference for｜sự ưa thích đối với
in preference to｜thay vì; ưu tiên hơn
tip: Ưa thích điều gì dùng preference for, không dùng to.

senses.en: A period distinguished by particular events, developments, or ways of life.

ex.en: These old photographs remind us of a different era.
The digital era has transformed how people access information, creating both educational opportunities and new inequalities.

col: a new era｜một thời đại mới
the end of an era｜sự kết thúc của một thời đại
tip: era nhấn mạnh một thời kỳ có đặc điểm chung, không chỉ số năm cố định.

senses.en: A particular quality in someone's character or an organism's nature.

ex.en: Patience is the trait I admire most in my sister.
Although some personality traits are inherited, social experiences also influence how individuals behave in different situations.

tip: trait là danh từ đếm được, thường chỉ tính cách hoặc đặc điểm di truyền.

senses.en: Romantically or sexually attracted to people of the same sex.

senses.zh: liên quan đến người đồng tính
senses.en: Relating to gay people, their lives, or their culture.

ex.en: My uncle is gay and lives with his husband.
Schools can promote inclusion by ensuring that gay students receive the same respect and support as their peers.

col: gay rights｜quyền của người đồng tính
openly gay｜công khai là người đồng tính
tip: Thường là tính từ; nghĩa “vui vẻ” nay hiếm dùng.

senses.en: showing understanding and care for someone's difficulties
showing approval or support for an idea or proposal

ex.en: My manager was sympathetic when I explained my difficulties.
Employers who are sympathetic to carers' needs can improve staff wellbeing by offering flexible working arrangements.

col: a sympathetic listener｜người biết lắng nghe và cảm thông
a sympathetic attitude｜thái độ thông cảm
sympathetic to a proposal｜tán thành một đề xuất
tip: Thường đi với to hoặc towards; không có nghĩa “dễ mến” (đó là likeable).

senses.en: a young person developing from a child into an adult

senses.zh: thuộc tuổi dậy thì; thuộc thanh thiếu niên
senses.en: relating to the stage between childhood and adulthood

ex.en: The club offers cooking classes for adolescents after school.
Regular physical activity can improve adolescent mental health and support the development of lasting social connections.

col: adolescent development｜sự phát triển của thanh thiếu niên
adolescent behaviour｜hành vi của thanh thiếu niên
adolescent mental health｜sức khoẻ tâm thần thanh thiếu niên
tip: Có thể là danh từ hoặc tính từ; trang trọng hơn teenager.

senses.en: a male peafowl with long, colourful feathers it spreads out

ex.en: The peacock spread its brilliant feathers beside the pond.
The elaborate display of a peacock illustrates how mate selection can influence the evolution of animal appearance.

col: as proud as a peacock｜kiêu hãnh như con công
tip: Nói chính xác, peacock là công đực, công cái là peahen.

senses.en: Completely, with nothing left out.

ex.en: I entirely forgot about the soup on the stove.
A transport system powered entirely by renewable energy could significantly reduce a city's carbon emissions.

col: entirely dependent on｜hoàn toàn phụ thuộc vào
tip: not entirely nghĩa là không hoàn toàn, chứ không phải hoàn toàn không.

senses.zh: cuộc diễu hành; cuộc duyệt binh
senses.en: An organised procession of people or vehicles watched by spectators.
To walk together in an organised public procession.
To show something publicly, often to attract admiration.

ex.en: Children waved flags as the parade passed our balcony.
A cultural parade allows communities to celebrate their traditions and share them with people from different backgrounds.

col: a street parade｜diễu hành trên phố
a carnival parade｜diễu hành lễ hội
parade through the streets｜diễu hành qua các con phố
tip: parade thiên về diễu hành trình diễn; biểu tình phản đối thường dùng march.

senses.en: Having a helpful or positive effect.

ex.en: A short walk after lunch is beneficial for digestion.
Access to green spaces is particularly beneficial to urban residents who have limited opportunities for outdoor exercise.

col: beneficial to health｜có lợi cho sức khoẻ
mutually beneficial｜đôi bên cùng có lợi
tip: Thường đi với to hoặc for để chỉ có lợi cho ai hay mặt nào.

senses.zh: kinh điển; được công nhận là xuất sắc
senses.en: Widely admired for lasting quality and value.
Showing the most recognizable features of a particular kind.
A work admired over time for its excellent quality.

ex.en: We watched a classic film together after dinner.
This housing project is a classic example of how thoughtful design can improve urban life.

col: timeless classic｜tác phẩm kinh điển bất hủ
tip: classic là kinh điển hoặc điển hình; nhạc cổ điển dùng classical.

senses.en: to breathe noisily through your nose and throat while sleeping
a noisy breath made by someone who is sleeping

ex.en: My brother snores so loudly that the dog leaves.
People who snore regularly may benefit from medical advice, particularly if their breathing stops briefly during sleep.

col: a loud snore｜một tiếng ngáy lớn
tip: Là động từ thường nội động từ; snoring có thể chỉ hiện tượng ngáy.

senses.en: Break down food inside the body so it can be used.
Think about information until you understand it.

senses.zh: bản tóm tắt; tạp chí văn tuyển
senses.en: A short collection of the main points from longer material.

ex.en: My stomach finds heavy meals difficult to digest.
Students need sufficient time to digest complex information before applying it to unfamiliar problems.

col: a monthly digest｜bản tóm tắt hàng tháng
tip: Danh từ nhấn âm đầu, đọc /ˈdaɪdʒest/.

senses.en: A short phrase expressing someone's guiding belief or purpose.

ex.en: My grandmother's motto was always to help others first.
A school's motto can express shared values, but daily teaching practices must also reflect those principles.

col: a personal motto｜phương châm cá nhân
a school motto｜khẩu hiệu của trường
adopt a motto｜chọn một châm ngôn
tip: motto nhấn mạnh niềm tin dẫn đường; slogan thường là khẩu hiệu quảng bá.

senses.en: To suffer something difficult or unpleasant without giving up.

senses.zh: tồn tại lâu dài; bền bỉ
senses.en: To continue existing despite difficulties or the passage of time.

ex.en: We endured hours of noise while workers repaired the roof.
Communities in dry regions must endure prolonged water shortages as climate patterns become less predictable.

col: endure for centuries｜tồn tại hàng thế kỷ
tip: Nghĩa “chịu đựng” đi thẳng với tân ngữ; nghĩa “tồn tại lâu” có thể không có tân ngữ.

senses.en: A barrier across a river that holds back water.
To block a river or stream with a barrier.

ex.en: We watched water rushing through the gates of the dam.
Building a dam can provide renewable electricity, but it may also disrupt river ecosystems and displace communities.

col: dam a river｜đắp đập chắn sông
tip: dam là đập chặn nước; reservoir là hồ chứa nước.

senses.zh: lợi ích; mục đích; vì (ai, điều gì)
senses.en: Someone's benefit or the purpose behind an action.

ex.en: We kept our voices down for the baby's sake.
Governments should protect natural habitats for the sake of future generations rather than prioritising short-term profits.

col: for someone's sake｜vì lợi ích của ai
for the sake of clarity｜để cho rõ ràng
tip: Thường dùng trong for the sake of hoặc for someone's sake.

senses.en: To clean and brush an animal or make yourself neat.
A man who is getting married or has just married.

senses.zh: đào tạo; chuẩn bị cho (vai trò)
senses.en: To prepare someone for a particular role or responsibility.

ex.en: We groom our pony every morning before riding.
Some organisations groom promising employees for leadership roles through structured training and regular mentoring.

col: groom a horse｜chải lông cho ngựa
bride and groom｜cô dâu và chú rể
groom someone for leadership｜đào tạo ai làm lãnh đạo
tip: Đào tạo ai cho vai trò nào dùng groom someone for a role.

senses.en: Relating to the regions around the Earth's poles.
Completely opposite in character, direction, or opinion.

ex.en: We watched a film about animals in polar regions.
Rising global temperatures threaten polar ecosystems by reducing the sea ice that many species depend on.

col: polar ice caps｜chỏm băng ở cực
polar opposites｜hai thái cực đối lập
tip: polar chỉ vùng hai cực; polar opposites nghĩa là hoàn toàn trái ngược nhau.

senses.zh: niềm vui sướng; sự thích thú
senses.en: a feeling of great pleasure or happiness

senses.zh: làm vui sướng; làm hài lòng
senses.en: to give someone great pleasure

senses.zh: điều thú vị; điều làm vui lòng
senses.en: something or someone that gives great pleasure

ex.en: The children squealed with delight when the puppy arrived.
Public gardens can bring delight to city residents while providing valuable spaces for relaxation and social interaction.

col: to someone's delight｜làm ai vui mừng là
take delight in｜lấy làm thích thú
delight in doing something｜thích làm việc gì
tip: delighted chỉ người cảm thấy vui; delightful chỉ sự vật gây vui thích.

senses.en: a state of not knowing what is true or will happen
something that is unknown or cannot be predicted

ex.en: The delayed flight left us facing hours of uncertainty.
Economic uncertainty can discourage businesses from investing in new equipment or hiring additional staff.

col: economic uncertainty｜sự bất ổn kinh tế
a period of uncertainty｜một giai đoạn bất định
uncertainty about the future｜sự bất định về tương lai
tip: Chỉ trạng thái không chắc chắn nói chung thì không đếm được; các yếu tố chưa rõ cụ thể có thể dùng số nhiều.

senses.en: Used to express happiness, excitement, or approval.

ex.en: Hurrah, the rain has stopped and we can play outside!
The volunteers shouted hurrah when they learned that their campaign had saved the local park.

col: a final hurrah｜màn trình diễn cuối cùng ngoạn mục
tip: Nghĩa như hooray; thường đứng riêng, theo sau là dấu chấm than.

senses.zh: tái tạo được (năng lượng, tài nguyên)
senses.en: Naturally replaced and therefore available for continued use.
Able to be extended for another period of time.

ex.en: Our new solar panels provide renewable energy for the house.
Investment in renewable energy can create jobs while reducing a country's dependence on imported fossil fuels.

col: renewable contract｜hợp đồng có thể gia hạn
tip: Danh từ renewables dùng ở số nhiều, chỉ các nguồn năng lượng tái tạo.

senses.zh: dù che nắng; mái che nắng
senses.en: an object that blocks sunlight to provide shade

ex.en: We opened the sunshade above our garden table.
Installing a sunshade over each outdoor seating area can make public spaces more comfortable in summer.

col: beach sunshade｜dù che nắng bãi biển
car sunshade｜tấm chắn nắng ô tô
under a sunshade｜dưới dù che nắng
tip: sunshade dùng để che nắng; umbrella thường là ô che mưa.

senses.zh: sự loại bỏ; sự dọn đi
senses.en: The act of taking something away from a place.

senses.zh: sự cách chức; sự bãi nhiệm
senses.en: The act of dismissing someone from an official position.

senses.zh: việc chuyển nhà; sự dọn nhà
senses.en: The process of moving belongings to a new home.

ex.en: Stain removal is easier if you act quickly.
The removal of unnecessary packaging could significantly reduce the amount of household waste sent to landfill.

tip: Nghĩa “chuyển nhà” dùng chủ yếu trong Anh–Anh; công ty chuyển nhà là removal company.

senses.en: to turn around a central point or axis
to change positions or duties in a regular order

ex.en: Rotate the pot so each side gets some sunlight.
Some hospitals rotate staff between departments to broaden their experience and improve cooperation across medical teams.

col: rotate clockwise｜xoay theo chiều kim đồng hồ
tip: Dùng được cả ngoại động từ lẫn nội động từ: rotate the wheel; the wheel rotates.

senses.zh: sự nhiệt tình; sự hăng hái
senses.en: Strong interest and excitement about something you enjoy or value.

ex.en: The children showed real enthusiasm for planting their own vegetables.
Teachers who demonstrate enthusiasm for their subjects can motivate students to explore ideas beyond the classroom.

tip: Nhiệt tình với điều gì dùng enthusiasm for; thường không đếm được.

senses.en: move quietly and secretly to avoid being noticed
take or do something secretly without permission

ex.en: I sneaked downstairs for water while everyone was asleep.
Some students sneak phones into examinations, highlighting the need for clearer rules and stronger supervision.

col: sneak something past someone｜lén đưa vật gì qua mặt ai
tip: Quá khứ thường là sneaked; Anh–Mỹ cũng hay dùng snuck.

senses.en: A special chair used by a king or queen.
The position or power of a king or queen.

ex.en: The queen sat on a throne beside the window.
Her accession to the throne marked a significant change in the country's political relationship with its neighbours.

col: sit on a throne｜ngồi trên ngai vàng
heir to the throne｜người thừa kế ngai vàng
tip: the throne có thể chỉ ngôi vua, không nhất thiết là chiếc ngai thật.

senses.en: a disadvantage or negative aspect of something

ex.en: The only downside of this flat is the noise.
One downside of remote working is that employees may have fewer opportunities to build strong professional relationships.

col: a potential downside｜một nhược điểm tiềm ẩn
on the downside｜xét về mặt bất lợi
tip: Hay dùng the downside of/to sth để chỉ mặt trái của việc gì.

senses.en: To accompany someone to guide or protect them

senses.zh: người hộ tống; đoàn hộ tống
senses.en: A person or group accompanying someone for protection or guidance

ex.en: A staff member escorted us to the waiting room.
Trained volunteers can escort elderly residents to medical appointments, improving access to essential healthcare services.

col: escort someone to｜hộ tống ai đến
a police escort｜đội cảnh sát hộ tống
tip: Động từ nhấn âm sau; danh từ Anh /ˈeskɔːt/, Mỹ /ˈeskɔːrt/.

senses.en: to send signals, information, or energy between places
to pass a disease from one living thing to another

ex.en: These tiny sensors transmit temperature readings to my phone.
Improved satellite networks can transmit vital information to remote communities during floods and other natural disasters.

tip: Quá khứ transmitted, dạng tiếp diễn transmitting, đều gấp đôi chữ t.

senses.zh: sự nhận dạng; sự giám định
senses.en: the process of establishing who or what someone or something is
a document that proves who you are

senses.zh: sự đồng cảm; sự đồng nhất
senses.en: a feeling of connection with another person or group

ex.en: The receptionist asked me to show some identification.
Early identification of learning difficulties allows schools to provide appropriate support before students fall behind.

col: proof of identification｜giấy tờ tuỳ thân
tip: Khi chỉ giấy tờ tuỳ thân thường không đếm được, có thể viết tắt là ID.

senses.zh: sự chuyển động; sự vận động
senses.en: the act or process of moving

senses.zh: kiến nghị; đề nghị chính thức
senses.en: a formal proposal discussed and voted on at a meeting
to signal something using a movement of your hand or head

ex.en: The gentle motion of the boat made me sleepy.
The council passed a motion to improve public transport and reduce traffic in residential areas.

col: pass a motion｜thông qua một kiến nghị
motion to someone｜ra hiệu cho ai
tip: Kiến nghị có thể dùng pass hoặc reject; in motion nghĩa là đang chuyển động.

senses.zh: sự điên rồ; hành động cực kỳ dại dột
senses.en: Extremely foolish, unreasonable, or dangerous behaviour.
An old-fashioned term for severe mental illness.

ex.en: Driving through this thick fog would be absolute madness.
Critics described the destruction of healthy forests for temporary economic gains as environmental madness.

col: a moment of madness｜một phút bồng bột
tip: Cách dùng chỉ bệnh tâm thần đã lỗi thời và có thể gây xúc phạm; không dùng để chẩn đoán.

senses.en: Not knowing or noticing that something exists or is happening.

ex.en: I was unaware that my umbrella was still outside.
Many consumers remain unaware of the environmental damage caused by the production of cheap clothing.

col: completely unaware｜hoàn toàn không hay biết
tip: Thường dùng be unaware of hoặc be unaware that + mệnh đề.

senses.zh: người cùng trang lứa; người ngang hàng
senses.en: Someone of similar age, status, or ability

senses.zh: nhìn chăm chú; nheo mắt nhìn
senses.en: To look carefully, especially when something is difficult to see
A person holding a British noble title

ex.en: She peered through the window to see the kitten.
Students often gain confidence when they receive constructive feedback from their peers during collaborative classroom activities.

col: peer pressure｜áp lực từ bạn bè đồng trang lứa
tip: Danh từ thường dùng số nhiều peers; động từ thường đi với through, at hoặc into.

senses.zh: sự phòng thủ; sự bảo vệ
senses.en: Action taken to protect someone or something from attack or harm.

senses.zh: sự biện hộ; lời bào chữa
senses.en: An argument or explanation supporting someone accused or criticized.

senses.zh: hàng phòng ngự; cầu thủ phòng ngự
senses.en: Players or actions that stop opponents from scoring in sport.

ex.en: The thick walls provided a strong defence against attackers.
Restoring coastal wetlands offers a natural defence against flooding while creating valuable habitats for wildlife.

tip: Anh–Anh viết defence; Anh–Mỹ viết defense.

senses.en: a straight line through a circle's centre joining opposite edges

ex.en: The round cake measures thirty centimetres in diameter.
Engineers must calculate the diameter of water pipes carefully to ensure an adequate supply to growing cities.

tip: Đường kính là diameter, bán kính là radius; sau số đo thường dùng in diameter.

senses.en: Having a higher rank or more experience within an organisation.

senses.zh: lớn tuổi; thuộc người cao tuổi
senses.en: Older than someone else, or relating to older people.

senses.zh: học sinh năm cuối; người cao tuổi
senses.en: A final-year school or college student, or an older adult.

ex.en: A senior nurse showed me how to change the bandage.
Senior managers should consult employees before introducing policies that significantly affect working conditions across the organisation.

col: senior management｜ban quản lý cấp cao
a senior position｜vị trí cấp cao
senior to someone｜cấp bậc cao hơn ai
tip: So sánh cấp bậc dùng senior to, không dùng senior than.

senses.en: Make a device, system, or process start working.

ex.en: Press this button to activate the outdoor lights.
Smart sensors can activate ventilation systems automatically when indoor air quality falls below acceptable levels.

col: activate an account｜kích hoạt tài khoản
activate an alarm｜kích hoạt báo động
activate a system｜khởi động hệ thống
tip: Nhấn mạnh việc làm cho thiết bị hoặc hệ thống bắt đầu hoạt động; trái nghĩa là deactivate.

senses.en: To regard something as caused or created by someone or something.
A quality or feature of a person or thing.

ex.en: She attributes her good health to daily walks.
Researchers attribute the decline in local air pollution to stricter controls on industrial emissions.

col: attribute success to｜quy thành công cho
be attributed to｜được cho là do
a key attribute｜một đặc điểm then chốt
tip: attribute A to B nghĩa là quy A cho B; danh từ nhấn âm đầu.

senses.en: Designed to perform several different tasks.

ex.en: Our multifunction printer can scan documents and make copies.
Multifunction devices can help small businesses save office space by combining several essential services in one machine.

col: a multifunction printer｜máy in đa chức năng
a multifunction device｜thiết bị đa chức năng
a multifunction display｜màn hình đa chức năng
tip: Là tính từ, thường đứng trước danh từ chỉ thiết bị; cũng có thể dùng multifunctional.

senses.en: To understand and care about someone's suffering or difficulties.
To agree with someone's ideas, aims, or position.

ex.en: I sympathize with you; losing a pet is painful.
Many residents sympathize with workers demanding better conditions, although they find the transport strike inconvenient.

col: sympathize with someone｜thông cảm với ai
sympathize with a cause｜ủng hộ một sự nghiệp
tip: Không đi thẳng với tân ngữ: dùng sympathize with; Anh–Anh cũng viết sympathise.

senses.en: At a regular rate, without sudden changes or interruptions.
In a controlled way, without shaking or losing balance.

ex.en: Rain fell steadily as we walked back from the station.
The proportion of households using renewable electricity has risen steadily over the past decade.

tip: Trong viết biểu đồ hay dùng rise steadily, chỉ tăng đều chứ không tăng vọt.

senses.en: A nutrient needed for growth and repair of body tissues.

ex.en: These beans add protein to our vegetable soup.
A balanced plant-based diet can provide sufficient protein when it includes varied sources such as beans and nuts.

tip: Khi là chất dinh dưỡng thường không đếm được; khi chỉ các loại khác nhau thì đếm được.

senses.en: Reasoning that connects ideas in a clear, consistent way.
The study of rules for reasoning correctly.

ex.en: I understand the logic behind your plan to save money.
The logic behind investing in public transport is that fewer cars can reduce urban congestion.

col: the logic behind something｜logic đằng sau việc gì
tip: Thường không đếm được; the logic behind nghĩa là lẽ đằng sau điều gì.

senses.zh: bức xạ; năng lượng bức xạ
senses.en: Energy travelling through space or matter as waves or particles.
Medical treatment using radiation to destroy cancer cells.

ex.en: This special glass blocks much of the sun's ultraviolet radiation.
Workers in nuclear facilities require protective equipment and regular monitoring to limit their exposure to radiation.

col: ultraviolet radiation｜bức xạ tia cực tím
exposure to radiation｜phơi nhiễm bức xạ
tip: Thường không đếm được; bức xạ không chỉ là bức xạ hạt nhân mà gồm cả ánh nắng.

senses.en: Designed for a particular purpose or requiring specific expert knowledge.

ex.en: The mechanic used specialised tools to repair my bicycle.
Hospitals need specialised equipment and trained staff to provide effective treatment for patients with complex conditions.

tip: Anh–Anh thường viết specialised, Anh–Mỹ thường viết specialized.

senses.en: An evergreen tree with needles, or the wood it produces.

senses.zh: khao khát; héo hon vì nhớ
senses.en: Long deeply for someone or something, sometimes becoming weak.

ex.en: We rested beneath a tall pine after lunch.
Planting pine trees can support timber production, but diverse native forests generally provide richer wildlife habitats.

col: pine for someone｜khắc khoải nhớ ai
pine away｜héo hon vì nhớ nhung
tip: pine for nghĩa là khao khát hay nhớ nhung; pine away nghĩa là héo hon dần.

senses.en: People, especially those belonging to a particular group.
Connected with the traditional culture of ordinary people.
Music rooted in the traditions of a community.

ex.en: Local folk gather here to chat every evening.
Traditional folk music can help younger generations understand the cultural heritage of their communities.

tip: Chỉ “mọi người” thì dùng động từ số nhiều; my folks trong khẩu ngữ là bố mẹ.

senses.en: Controlled behaviour achieved by following rules or managing yourself.
A particular field of study or knowledge.

senses.zh: trừng phạt; rèn luyện kỷ luật
senses.en: To punish misconduct or train someone to follow rules.

ex.en: Practising the piano every morning takes patience and discipline.
Universities increasingly encourage collaboration between researchers from different disciplines to address complex environmental challenges.

col: discipline yourself to do something｜tự ép mình làm việc gì
tip: Nghĩa “kỷ luật” thường không đếm được; nghĩa “ngành học” thì đếm được.

senses.en: a flat outdoor area beside a building for sitting
a flat strip of land cut into a slope
a row of houses joined by shared side walls

ex.en: We had breakfast on the terrace overlooking the garden.
Farmers maintain each terrace carefully to reduce soil erosion and grow crops on steep mountain slopes.

col: a roof terrace｜sân thượng trên mái
a sunny terrace｜sân hiên đầy nắng
a terrace of houses｜một dãy nhà liền kề
tip: terrace thường là khoảng ngoài trời khá rộng, không giống balcony.

senses.en: The finger next to the thumb.

ex.en: She pressed the doorbell gently with her forefinger.
Participants used their forefinger to press a button whenever they noticed a change on the screen.

col: thumb and forefinger｜ngón cái và ngón trỏ
tip of the forefinger｜đầu ngón trỏ
tip: Đồng nghĩa với index finger, đều là ngón trỏ kề ngón cái.

senses.en: In a worried or nervous way.
With a strong desire for something to happen.

ex.en: He waited anxiously outside while the vet examined his cat.
Many graduates anxiously await job offers as competition for entry-level positions continues to increase.

tip: Thường mang sắc thái lo lắng; mong đợi vui vẻ thì dùng eagerly.

senses.en: A line marking where one area ends and another begins
A limit defining acceptable behaviour or the scope of something

ex.en: A low stone wall marks the boundary of our garden.
Clear boundaries between work and personal life can protect employees' mental health and reduce long-term stress.

col: a national boundary｜biên giới quốc gia
cross a boundary｜vượt qua ranh giới
push the boundaries｜phá vỡ giới hạn
tip: boundary nhấn mạnh đường phân chia; border thường dùng cho biên giới quốc gia hay khu vực.

senses.en: to build something again after damage or destruction

senses.zh: khôi phục; xây lại (quan hệ, niềm tin)
senses.en: to make something strong or successful again

ex.en: We plan to rebuild the garden wall this weekend.
After severe flooding, local authorities must rebuild essential infrastructure and help affected communities recover.

col: rebuild a house｜xây lại ngôi nhà
rebuild trust｜xây dựng lại niềm tin
rebuild the economy｜phục hồi nền kinh tế
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là rebuilt.

senses.en: a substance used with water to clean clothes or surfaces

ex.en: I added detergent before starting the washing machine.
Using excessive detergent wastes money and may increase the amount of chemicals entering local waterways.

col: liquid detergent｜chất tẩy rửa dạng lỏng
mild detergent｜chất tẩy rửa dịu nhẹ
tip: Chỉ chất tẩy rửa nói chung thường không đếm được; chỉ các loại thì đếm được.

senses.en: Working independently for different clients rather than one employer
Independently, for different clients rather than one employer
To work independently, offering services to different clients

ex.en: My sister is a freelance designer who works from home.
Freelance work offers flexibility, but workers may struggle to maintain a stable income without regular contracts.

tip: Trong work freelance, freelance là trạng từ; freelancer là người làm nghề tự do.

senses.en: The line where the sky seems to meet land or sea.
The limits of someone's knowledge, experience, or interests.

ex.en: We watched a small boat disappear beyond the horizon.
Studying abroad can broaden students' horizons by exposing them to unfamiliar customs and different approaches to learning.

col: on the horizon｜ở chân trời; sắp xảy ra
broaden your horizons｜mở rộng tầm nhìn
beyond the horizon｜ngoài đường chân trời
tip: Nghĩa “tầm nhìn” thường dùng số nhiều: broaden your horizons.

senses.en: A particular aspect of a situation, problem, or experience.
A measurement of something, such as its length or width.
An independent direction of measurement, such as length, width, or height.

ex.en: Cooking together added a new dimension to our friendship.
Urban planning has a social dimension, since the design of neighbourhoods can influence how frequently residents interact.

col: a social dimension｜khía cạnh xã hội
add a new dimension｜thêm một khía cạnh mới
in three dimensions｜ở dạng ba chiều
tip: Khi chỉ kích thước dài rộng cao cụ thể, thường dùng số nhiều dimensions.

senses.en: As a result of what has just been stated
In this way

ex.en: The road was flooded; thus, we took another route.
Improved public transport can reduce dependence on private cars, thus lowering emissions and easing urban congestion.

col: thus reducing costs｜do đó giảm chi phí
thus enabling｜do đó giúp có thể
tip: thus là trạng từ, không dùng chỉ dấu phẩy để nối hai mệnh đề độc lập.

senses.en: cloth made by weaving, knitting, or other fibre processing
relating to cloth or its production

ex.en: The market stall sells colourful textiles for making curtains.
The textile industry can reduce water pollution by adopting cleaner production methods and treating wastewater effectively.

tip: Chỉ các loại hàng dệt nói chung thường dùng số nhiều textiles.

senses.en: A skilled person, especially a man, who makes things by hand.

ex.en: The craftsman carved a wooden bird for the display.
Supporting local craftsmen can preserve traditional skills while providing communities with sustainable sources of income.

col: a skilled craftsman｜thợ thủ công lành nghề
a master craftsman｜bậc thầy thủ công
a traditional craftsman｜thợ thủ công truyền thống
tip: Số nhiều là craftsmen; cách nói trung tính về giới là craftsperson.

senses.en: to release gas, heat, light, or sound

ex.en: These small lamps emit a soft, warm light.
Factories that emit harmful gases should install cleaner technology to reduce their impact on public health.

col: emit greenhouse gases｜thải khí nhà kính
tip: Quá khứ emitted, dạng tiếp diễn emitting, đều gấp đôi chữ t.

senses.zh: sự thiếu kiên nhẫn; sự bực bội
senses.en: annoyance caused by waiting, delays, or other people's behaviour

senses.zh: sự nóng lòng; sự sốt ruột
senses.en: a strong desire for something to happen soon

ex.en: She tapped her foot with impatience as the queue stalled.
Growing impatience with unreliable public transport may encourage commuters to use private cars, increasing urban congestion.

col: impatience with delays｜thiếu kiên nhẫn trước sự chậm trễ
show impatience｜tỏ ra thiếu kiên nhẫn
growing impatience｜sự bực bội ngày một tăng
tip: Thường không đếm được; thiếu kiên nhẫn với ai hay việc gì thường dùng with.

senses.en: produced without artificial fertilizers or most synthetic pesticides

senses.zh: thuộc chất hữu cơ; thuộc sinh vật
senses.en: relating to living things or carbon-based substances
developing gradually and naturally rather than through outside intervention

ex.en: She buys organic carrots from a nearby farm.
Organic farming can support biodiversity, although its lower yields may require more land for food production.

tip: Trong thực phẩm nghĩa là sản xuất hữu cơ; trong hoá học thường chỉ hợp chất chứa carbon.

senses.en: to decide something is not worth considering
to officially remove someone from their job
to tell someone or a group they may leave

ex.en: Don't dismiss her idea before you hear the details.
Governments should not dismiss public concerns about the long-term environmental effects of industrial expansion.

col: dismiss concerns｜gạt bỏ mối lo ngại
dismiss an idea｜bác bỏ một ý tưởng
dismiss someone from a job｜sa thải ai khỏi công việc
dismiss something as irrelevant｜gạt bỏ điều gì vì cho là không liên quan
tip: dismiss A as B: cho A là B nên gạt bỏ.
